source_revision: The commit containing this evidence directory

minio.build: go install github.com/minio/minio@v0.0.0-20250907161309-07c3a429bfed; built locally from pinned official source, not a release binary

environment.proxy_scope: HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/ALL_PROXY removed case-insensitively from the command subprocess environment only; global configuration unchanged

actual_process_proof: Archive child killed at DETACHED, uploaded-before-checkpoint, EXPORTED and COMPLETE; shipped archived CLI archives, repeats and reads. Real MinIO rejects invalid signatures and conditional overwrites, persists object versions across process kill/restart, and reads the verified version after a newer version is written.
scope: Event/audit monthly partitions, operator lookup and safe inbox/DONE-outbox expiry cleanup. Full M1/M4, worker replay RPC, cold-object deletion, production bucket policies and capacity targets are not established.
development_note: Initial integration exposed UTC/local timestamp scan handling. Debug runs also encountered Windows executable sharing and stale proxy module-metadata fetches; build environment was scoped and CLI build context separated from runtime fixture context. A later full run passed before final backlog/timezone changes and is not the retained evidence. The next run exposed a misplaced read-transaction commit causing rolled-back checkpoints and repeated uploads; it was explicitly stopped after diagnosis, then fixed and given a byte-boundary regression. This retained run uses frozen final sources, a new isolated cluster, and no assertion retries.
